title: Fun crew. Party boat more...
text: Fun crew. Party boat more than a tour, but tons of fun! Cava was delicious! Hard to find the starting place so give yourself extra time
author: PaulaJayne_W

title: Fabulous sailing with Connor and Belen
text: Connor and Belen gave us a beautiful sailing experience, with the sails up almost the whole time. My husband even took the helm himself and did some tacking. The snacks and tapas were delicious, and the 2 hours just zipped by. Great way to see some of the America's Cup boats and supporter boats, too!
author: Lauren_M

title: Great boat ride
text: It was a great time. The captain helped my husband when he got sea sick and made the trip worth it. Thank you for such a great experience!
author: breeannar2024

title: Best experience ever!
text: Victoria and Camilla gave use the best experience! They made sure that we were having a great time and that our drinks were never empty. Couldn’t have had a better experience!
author: gabbiek2024

title: Amazing 10/10
text: So worth it!! We had so much fun - the food and drinks were amazing, the boat was gorgeous and all in all made our trip. Maria was amazing with planning and ensuring that we all had the best time and got the most out of it. she’s the best. Would highly recommend to anyone who’s looking to explore Barcelona from the water :)
author: alexbZ1514BM

title: Amazing day of sailing with Ivy and Maria.
text: Ivy and Maria were amazing.  They were so much fun to spend the day with.  The tapas and cava were delicious too.  Definitely a must when you’re in Spain.
author: GoPlaces754779

title: Sailing with IVY
text:
The sailing experience with my captain Ivy amazing. Not only was I informed about the sky line I was also given proper sailing instruction and allowed to sail the boat. The experience was 5 stars. The only negative things were all on Via Tour. THEY dropped the ball on directions on how to get to the boat.  Via Tour had statements that a person with a red and white arm band would meet us.  The operator never approved these directions. The boat birth number was wrong again all on Via Tour
The lunch after the sail was TOP quality.
I will use them again again hats off to IVY
Via tour you are bette
author: Timothy_B

title: Best time!
text: We had the best time! My friends and I literally loved it so much, the food and drink were awesome and the staff was so friendly and helpful. Maria was amazing with the planning!!
author: clairetI5112QP

title: Best boat tour ever !
text: We had an amazing Experience, we felt secure and really welcoming atmosphere.  The food and the drink were also really nice. We definitely recommend that tour.
author: 919malm

title: Chilled day on the water
text:
Fantastic boat trip, very chilled and lovely platter of food along with some drinks, a perfect day on the water. Our host Maria was so friendly and happy to answer all our questions, Captain Evie was very professional and even let us take the controls which was great fun. It was too cold for a swim (early April) but we could have if we wanted to!!
Highly recommended
author: Gavin T
